hero.description: Sciecola automatically analyzes and classifies scientific articles against the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) using artificial intelligence.

hero.subtitle: Sciecola uses artificial intelligence to classify scientific research into the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals — automatically, accurately, and visually.

features_section.title: Everything You Need
features_section.subtitle: From automated classification to impact analysis — one platform for every SDG research need.

features.title: Automated SDG Classification
features.desc: Our AI automatically classifies scientific articles and researcher profiles into the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals.

features.title: ORCID & DOI Analysis
features.desc: Enter a researcher ORCID or article DOI to get an instant, detailed map of SDG contributions.

features.title: Research Explorer
features.desc: Explore global research trends, SDG distribution over time, and discover potential collaborators with interactive visualizations.

features.title: Collaboration Network
features.desc: Build connections across institutions and countries. Find researchers with similar SDG focus areas for collaboration.

features.title: AI Insights
features.desc: Get deep AI-generated insights into research trends, research gaps, and SDG collaboration opportunities.

features.title: Research Matching
features.desc: A smart platform that matches researchers, institutions, and industry partners based on SDG alignment.

sdg_section.title: 17 Sustainable Development Goals
sdg_section.subtitle: Our platform covers every UN 2030 SDG — each publication is precisely mapped to the relevant goal.

how_it_works_section.title: How Sciecola Works
how_it_works_section.subtitle: Three simple steps to map your research impact against the global SDGs.

how_it_works.title: Enter an ORCID or DOI
how_it_works.desc: Type in a researcher ORCID or scientific article DOI. Our platform retrieves publication data automatically.

how_it_works.title: AI Classifies the SDGs
how_it_works.desc: Our AI model analyzes abstracts and publication content, then maps them onto one or more of the 17 UN SDGs.

how_it_works.title: Explore Results & Impact
how_it_works.desc: View interactive visualizations of SDG contributions, time trends, collaborations, and research impact metrics.
